items.title: Two Truths and a Lie
items.body: Each person offers two truths and one lie about themselves, and others guess the lie.

items.title: Have You Ever?
items.body: Invite light questions, such as “Have you ever flown in an airplane?” Have a few possibilities ready.

items.title: Would You Rather?
items.body: Offer a low-stakes pair, such as cake or pie.

items.title: Find 10 Things in Common
items.body: Look for shared interests or experiences, such as liking the color red. This may take more time than other options.

items.title: Ordinary small talk
items.body: A friendly question about the day, a game, or the weather can get a conversation rolling. Not every group needs a formal game.
